thread:
ken: quick PSA — after the runtime deploy (attn_v2 + quant-profile-3) we're seeing prefix-cache hit-rate drop ~88% -> ~72% for llama2-13B-quant workloads. p95 token latency up ~30ms on hosted. :eyes:

nina: timeline? which deploy id and region?

ken: deploy-bot: rolled attn_v2 kernel + quant tuning at 2026-03-15T02:10Z (build 20260315.7) to us-west-2. sample metrics from yesterday: 
```
prefix_cache.metrics: hit_rate=0.72, keys_seen=1_200_341, evictions=42_013
kernel_selector: attn_v2_quant_fast chosen ~80% for mid-length seqs
fallbacks: attn_v1 used ~0.9%
observed_p95_tokens: +30ms
```

sasha: I traced a few requests — looks like key canonicalization changed. attn_v2 introduced a flattened metadata map when we fused attention layers, and that changed insertion order. identical prompts now sometimes produce different prefix keys -> miss.

alex: can you paste a real example of mismatched keys?

sasha: example: 
```
prefix_key_new: model=llama2-13b|profile=quant3|prompt_hash=0x9ab3|layers=24|attn=attn_v2
prefix_key_old: model=llama2-13b|profile=quant3|attn=attn_v1|prompt_hash=0x9ab3|layers=24
```
The same prompt_hash but metadata token order differs after the attn metadata got injected earlier in the map. key generation uses iteration order of an unordered map.

nina: I can reproduce with the local harness — toggling the metadata injection position flips hits -> misses. Confirmed hit-rate drop on replay. :+1:

ken: short-term mitigation: we can canonicalize keys by sorting metadata kvs before stringifying. sorting cost ~1.2us/key in microbenchmarks but avoids huge miss penalty.

alex: +1 to deterministic canonicalization. Also need to ensure dedicated clusters' persisted cache format remains readable — add a migration shim.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-4821 "prefix-key-canonicalization-fix" and kicked off canary build 20260315.9 for us-west-2 (canary=5%).

ken: plan — patch runtime to sort metadata keys at key-gen + unit tests for various kernel metadata shapes, land to canary 5% then 25% then full. monitor prefix_cache.hit_rate and p95 tokens. roll back knob if regressions.

sasha: small follow-up — batching heuristic also shifted: kernel_selector now prefers attn_v2 for mid-length sequences which increased variance in which kernel handles warmup traffic, amplifying cache churn. I'll add a routing rule to prefer historically-stable kernels for warmup traffic in the canary.

nina: running a 12h replay across our prod traces overnight. will post numbers tomorrow morning. :coffee:
